senses.gloss: इ The third vowel, i short.

इ (इः) 1.
m. A name of Kāmadeva.
interj, oh, ah, alas.

इ अयति 1.
a. To move. With उत्
to rise; with अभि and उत् to rise,
to prosper.

इ (ङ-ल) Always with अधि making
अधीते 2.
d. irr. To read, to learn.

इ (ल) एति 2.
a. irr. To go. With
अति to pass time, to surpass;
with अधि to remember; with अनु
to follow; with अभि to get, to
approach, to serve; with अप to
depart; with उप to receive, to
approach; with निर् to go out;
with प्रति to believe; with वि to
expend; with अभि and उप to
arrive; with सं and उप to obtain.

ई The fourth vowel, i long as in
the words police, caprice.

ई (ईः) 1.
m. Name of Cupid.
f. Of
Lakshmī.
interj. Ah!

ई (ल) एति 2.
a. To desire; to move;
to eat. With उत् to appear 1.
d.
उदीते- (य, ङ) 4.
d. इयते to go.
